args.head: fix/banker-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Change

- `src/money.py`: switch from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so `round_money` matches the documented behavior and the test expectations:
  - `round_money(Decimal("2.675")) == Decimal("2.68")`
  - `round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == Decimal("2.66")`

## CI

CI passed on branch `fix/banker-rounding` (run `ci-0001`).

Requesting review from @alex.

Half-even rounds to the even neighbor, so 2.675 → 2.68. And 2.665 → 2.66 (since 2.66 has 6 even, 2.67 has 7 odd). Yes, that matches the test.

So the fix is to change `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in src/money.py.
